title: DE441-anchored Earth worldline in a local Galactic inertial approximation

source.name: NASA/JPL Horizons API, Earth center relative to Sun center
source.vectors: geometric Cartesian state, ICRF, TDB, km and km/s
source.cadence: 1 calendar year over 5,000 Julian years; candidate marker dates queried exactly

reference_event.origin: Earth center at the reference event; A.R.G.O. site offset is not modeled

coordinate_model.axes: ICRF Cartesian axes oriented using Galactic center and pole
coordinate_model.sun_galactic_motion: constant present solar velocity (230 km/s circular component plus Schönrich U,V,W) and constant local centripetal acceleration toward Galactic center
coordinate_model.limits: No complete Milky Way potential, Earth orientation, topocentric site state, witness route, or signal path. The approximate Galactic model is not a navigation solution.

candidate_events.context: Year associated with the proposed Jupiter-Saturn conjunction; this calendar day is a computational placeholder.
